We report on a three-waveguide electro-optic switch for compact photonic integrated circuits and data routing applications.

We also use the rotation phenomenon to realize thermo-optic and electro-optic switches.
Owing to efficient thermo-optic design, the power consumption is below 3 mW while the switching time is 1 µs.

The thermo-optic switch is measured with an optical extinction ratio of 20 dB, an on-off switching power of 18.2 mW, a thermo-optic tuning efficiency of 0.63 nm/mW, a rise time of 14.8 μs, and a fall time of 18.5 μs.
